testdescription: Control point: execute actual canonical write paths with the exact dual-gate matrix and safe, unsafe, and missing external configuration; for both-enabled valid live composition, touch Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View identities and inject provider, persistence, and queryability failures. Observation point: readiness invalidates first and exact touched IDs are returned; both-disabled produces explicit Pending or Stale and zero provider/vector work; half-enabled or unsafe/missing configuration fails closed with redacted action and zero provider/vector writes; both-enabled valid execution uses approved finite 1024-dimensional Qwen vectors, durably upserts or tombstones complete evidence, verifies all touched records through vector indexes, and reports Aligned only after global coherence; failures retain canonical authority, record Stale or Failed, and block semantic query; production performs no runId cleanup.

Control point: invoke ordinary typed queries only through public getSystemArchitecture(query) against aligned, disabled, pending, partial, stale, failed, and mismatched durable states; invoke omitted-query and graph-tidy controls.
